summary: Validated Cravitoo iter23 Step 1 (PDF gap items #1 corporate domain allowlist, #4 wired email triggers for vendor/menu/site activation, #7 site lifecycle Draft→Configured→Live). 22/22 backend pytest tests pass (14 existing + 8 new extended). End-to-end frontend UI flows validated: AllowedDomains add/remove/gmail-rejection, Sites lifecycle badges, SiteDetail Settings → Mark Configured → Activate Go Live (with POC name + 'Site is now Live' alert), and master-only Navbar Domains link gated for employees.

issues: Domain shown as '@itercheck-...com' with leading @ feels unusual since input is the bare domain — cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: Existing /app/backend/tests/test_iter23_step1.py uses class-level attribute (TestSiteLifecycle.site_id) shared across tests — works in pytest's default ordering but is fragile if test ordering changes; consider a module-level fixture for the created site_id.
OTP endpoint /api/auth/otp/request currently returns 200 for fresh corporate-domain emails even when the user doesn't exist yet — confirm this is intended (otherwise add user-must-exist gate).
AllowedDomains page does not show success toast after Add Domain — only relies on table refresh; consider a success indicator.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iter23_step1_extended.py (NEW - 8 additional smoke tests covering OTP gate, allowed-domain register success, GET /sites lifecycle field, lifecycle-unblocks-registration, vendor master-decision smoke, menu-decision smoke)
test_credentials: admin@cravitoo.com/admin123 (master_admin); employee@techcorp.com/employee123 (employee). techcorp.com is in allowlist, mapped to live site.

Allowed-domain rows are cleaned up by their tests; site rows are NOT cleaned and will accumulate in 'live'/'configured' state in DB — low priority cleanup task.

The frontend AllowedDomains modal has data-testid=domain-input/domain-notes-input/add-domain-btn.
